1.consolidated_definition: Lados del camino donde hay pasto que comen las reses realengas o las de aquellas personas que no tienen terreno suficiente con la yerba necesaria para que ellos coman.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Areas alongside the path where grass is present for grazing by cattle of royal descent or those owned by individuals lacking sufficient land with necessary pasture for their consumption.
